title: deployer: pave a generic dns.records.get (optional --filter mail)
description:
## .what

pave a generic `dns.records.get --wish <path> [--filter mail] [--format tree|bind]`: print the dns records a declared wish owes, as a tree or as a bind zone file a human can import by hand.

## .why

dns is often entered by hand (e.g. a cloudflare zone the robot may not write). the human needs the exact records, copy-pasteable. prior art is mail-specific: `ehmpathy/rhachet-roles-nheuron` `.agent/repo=.this/role=any/skills/mail.dns.records.get.sh` (main), which prints mx, spf, dmarc, dkim cnames, and ses verification records. a reviewer asked that it become generic, with mail as an optional filter.

## .ask

- read the records from the declared wish, not a hand list
- `--filter mail` narrows to mx / spf / dmarc / dkim / verification records
- `--format bind` emits a zone file for import
- unit test the record derivation; snapshot both formats
